---
title: "My Penguins"
---

## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(palmerpenguins)
average_bill_length = mean(penguins$bill_depth_mm, na.rm = TRUE)
table <- penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarize(average_bill_length)
glimpse(table)

penguins |>
  drop_na(bill_length_mm) |>  
  ggplot(aes(x = species, y = bill_length_mm)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = species), alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Avea=rage Bill Length by Penguin Species",
    x = "Species",
    y = "Bill Length (mm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
